Near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azamin]]&mdash;a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]&mdash;was '''assassinated''' by a [[Jedi strike team (Assassination of Darth Azamin)|strike team]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The operation was actually arranged by the Sith Lord [[Darth Decimus]] with the help of the Dark Councilor [[Darth Vowrawn]], and with his [[Death/Legends|death]] Darth Azamin was replaced as head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]] by Decimus.

==Prelude==
[[Darth Azamin]] was a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] during the later years of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> and Azamin served as head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]]. However, Azamin's fellow Dark Councilor [[Darth Vowrawn]]&mdash;a cunning political savant who had been on the Council since the beginning of the war<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>&mdash;struck a deal with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Decimus]] sometime before the end of the war<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> in [[3653 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline" /> In exchange for the elite [[Armageddon Battalion]] as his personal military force, Vowrawn arranged<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to learn the location of [[Darth Azamin's stronghold|Azamin's personal stronghold]] and when the Dark Councilor would be weakest.<ref name="Darth Decimus" />

==The assassination==
Taking the bait, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dispatched a [[Jedi strike team (Assassination of Darth Azamin)|strike team]] to Azamin's fortress, and the strike team managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Dark Councilor within the stronghold. However, the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the Jedi used to escape the fortress was sabotaged by Decimus<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> and Vowrawn's agents,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> causing it to explode and kill the entire strike team.<ref name="Darth Decimus" />

==Aftermath==
In the wake of Azamin's death, Darth Decimus was elevated to the Dark Council with the support Vowrawn, and Decimus assumed Azamin's seat at the head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]]. In that position, Decimus carefully planned an Imperial invasion of the Republic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]&mdash;a plan that he was put into action when [[Galactic War|war broke out]] after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|decade of tenuous peace]] following the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Darth Decimus" />

==Behind the scenes==
The death of Darth Azamin was first described in the Codex entry for Darth Decimus in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[LucasArts]] and [[BioWare]].<ref name="Darth Decimus" /> It was later expanded on in the game's [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which detailed Darth Vowrawn's role in the assassination and also identified Decimus&mdash;and thereby his predecessor Azamin&mdash;as the head of the Sphere of Military Strategy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
